messages:
Marco (Onboarding): Hey all — starting Meridian Health onboarding. Adding @Riley from Meridian. Quick thread to align stakeholders, measurable success criteria, and a 30-day timeline. Propose orientation week -> integration week -> pilot week. Any blockers?
Riley (Meridian): Thanks Marco — excited to get started. Priya (infra) and I will be main Meridian contacts. Our primary use case is a triage assistant for intake nurses. Success metrics: median latency < 2s, classification accuracy >= 90% on our test set, and SSO + audit logs enabled.
Aisha (CSM): Noted. I'll own enablement (playbooks, recordings, internal training). I need product contact list + sample data access for playbook examples.
Tom (SolutionsEng): I'll lead SDK + integration work. Can someone share expected request patterns? Also planning a quick perf run once we have a sample payload.
Priya (Meridian-Infra): We expect steady 2 qps during baseline, bursts to ~20 qps. Data sits behind our firewall — we need to confirm whether Hosted API with VPC peering works or if we need Private deployment.
Jordan (Security): Quick flag: Meridian handles PHI. We'll need SOC2 attestation docs, encryption details (KMS/HSM), and a data flow diagram before starting live tests. Priya, can you share security contact?
Marco (Onboarding): Good catch. Action items: 1) Aisha -> enablement plan + tentative training dates by Tue. 2) Tom -> integration checklist + perf test plan by Fri. 3) Priya -> confirm deployment option (hosted VPC vs Private) by Wed and share security contact. 4) Jordan -> security checklist template and required artifacts. I'll set weekly 30-min syncs.
calendar-bot: Meeting created — Meridian onboarding orientation: 2026-04-06 10:00 PT. Invites: Marco, Riley, Aisha, Tom, Priya, Jordan.
Riley (Meridian): One more thing — some incoming fields are PHI-mixed. We will need field-level redaction guidance and retention policy defined up front.
Aisha (CSM): We'll include a redaction/runbook in the enablement docs. Also will prepare a quick FAQ for nurses.
Tom (SolutionsEng): For initial perf smoke: example request we plan to use:
```bash
curl -s -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"input":"Patient intake: chest pain, onset 2 hours"}' \n  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
Tom (SolutionsEng): Plan: run 100 requests at 2 qps, then ramp bursts to 20 qps for 30s to observe latency tail. Will post results to the repo.
Priya (Meridian-Infra): Sounds good. If Private is required, timeline slips ~1 week for infra prep.
Marco (Onboarding): Understood — include that contingency in timeline.
Jordan (Security): Sharing a minimal checklist now: SOC2 report, data flow diagram, encryption-at-rest/in-transit, KMS details, retention policy, and access audit logs. I'll DM required templates.
Aisha (CSM): I'll draft enablement agenda: Day 0 orientation, Day 1 API walkthrough + quickstart, Day 3 integration clinic, Day 7 training + evaluation. Will share by Tue.
Riley (Meridian): Appreciate it. Also can we have a short evaluation rubric for acceptance criteria? e.g., latency, precision/recall benchmarks, and UI acceptance checklist.
Marco (Onboarding): Yes — Tom + Aisha to co-author a simple rubric. Tom will own perf numbers; Aisha will own user acceptance items.
Tom (SolutionsEng): I'll create a GitHub repo and add initial test harness. Posting link when ready.
Priya (Meridian-Infra): FYI — compliance contact is sara.k@meridian.health. Adding to thread for follow-ups.
Marco (Onboarding): Great — Sara added. Closing ask: please react with :thumbsup: if you agree with owners/timeline and we'll lock invites.
Riley (Meridian): :thumbsup:
Aisha (CSM): :thumbsup: I’ll send calendar invites for the enablement sessions.
Tom (SolutionsEng): :thumbsup: Creating repo now.
Jordan (Security): :thumbsup: I will DM templates and start the checklist.
Marco (Onboarding): Thanks everyone — I'll post a single-playbook summary after Aisha's plan arrives. We should be good to go for the orientation meeting.
